hash_1491c9f389606d05: We need a location on the target! Find 'em!
hash_65ca42ca06abff88: You get caught in that monsoon and you\xe2\x80\x99re done for, Strike Team! Better move like you mean it!
hash_65ca45ca06ac04a1: Me and my people are hunkered down, but we\xe2\x80\x99re all thinkin\xe2\x80\x99 bout you, Strike Team. Get your asses back to base!
hash_65ca44ca06ac02ee: Look at that thing. Ain\xe2\x80\x99t no fightin\xe2\x80\x99 weather like that. Hope you\xe2\x80\x99re headed for safety, team.
hash_1dc74926e473f309: Hear that? Winds are howling like a Texas twister. Storm\xe2\x80\x99s here, and it\xe2\x80\x99s a doozy.
hash_1dc74626e473edf0: Every piece of Aetherium-infused weaponry we have down here just started hummin\xe2\x80\x99. Storm must be sayin\xe2\x80\x99 hello.
hash_1dc74726e473efa3: Miller to Deadbolt Actual - got my people to safety, and just in time. It\xe2\x80\x99s starting to rain cats and dogs out here - undead cats and dogs.
hash_6f50142a0ffc2507: Miller to Deadbolt Actual - out here at the firing range and I got eyes on some of the ugliest damn clouds I ever saw. You on top of this?
hash_6f50152a0ffc26ba: Miller here - we just had a minor explosion in the ammo mod locker. Everyone\xe2\x80\x99s safe, but\xe2\x80\xa6 Well, you know what triggered this last time.
hash_6f50162a0ffc286d: Miller to Officer Greene - our automated perimeter turrets just went offline. I\xe2\x80\x99ve got the backups runnin\xe2\x80\x99 but thought you should know.
hash_4f623a38e9d55bd6: The Storm is altering the biology of every living thing inside it. You don\xe2\x80\x99t want to get caught in that!
hash_4f623938e9d55a23: Sensors are gone - and you will be too if you do not get out of there!
hash_4f623838e9d55870: Please - please hurry, my friends - this Storm is unnatural, and it is not waiting on anyone.
hash_4f623f38e9d56455: I have never seen a Storm grow so big, or so fast. You are running out of time, Strike Team.
hash_4f623e38e9d562a2: This is not the time to take in the sights, Strike Team! That Storm is growing exponentially!
hash_4f623d38e9d560ef: These readings - part of me wishes I could see the Storm in person. The rest of me is very glad I cannot.
hash_46cd95a5d1420aef: Okay... Okay - finally have some readings coming through. Look at that thing\xe2\x80\xa6 We got an apocalypse-level supercell on our hands, people!
hash_46cd96a5d1420ca2: Ay nonono - I have never seen cloud formations this tall. I hope our people are headed for safety, Commander.
hash_46cd97a5d1420e55: Commander - every locker in the bio-lab just started shaking. I think the Storm is here.
hash_46cd90a5d1420270: Not good, not good - one of our field labs just went silent. Only a full-blown Aether Storm could knock out those antennas.
hash_46cd91a5d1420423: Windows are starting to rattle down here. Everyone at base is going to have to wait this one out. Anyone still in the EZ won\xe2\x80\x99t have that option.
hash_46cd92a5d14205d6: Instruments aren\xe2\x80\x99t cooperating anymore. This is going to be a bad one. Very bad. Are our field teams safe yet?
hash_6e8be6e6508fe8dd: Hola. I have just lost contact with a network of high-altitude weather balloons above the EZ. That is, uh... That is not a good sign.
hash_6e8be3e6508fe3c4: Barrera to field teams - atmospheric electrometer readings show something big brewing over the EZ. Like, really big.
hash_6e8be4e6508fe577: Commander? Remember those HVT samples you wanted a report on? Well, they are umm\xe2\x80\xa6 They\xe2\x80\x99re twitching. I think they are responding to pulses of atmospheric energy.
hash_6e8be1e6508fe05e: Umm - Commander Greene, another cannister of ionized Aetherium just imploded down here. Last time this happened, you know what came next.
hash_6e8be2e6508fe211: This is Barrera. Doppler\xe2\x80\x99s showing severe wind and rain patterns forming above the EZ, and worse brewing. This doesn\xe2\x80\x99t look like ordinary weather to me.
hash_6e8bdfe6508fdcf8: Barrera to anyone who is listening - you need to get out of the EZ as soon as you can. Electrometers, seismographs, satellite imaging - it is all going haywire.
hash_4129339ba8715408: Strike Team, we\xe2\x80\x99re losing more equipment. Storm\xe2\x80\x99s not slowing down, so I recommend you speed up.
hash_4129369ba8715921: Storm\xe2\x80\x99s still growing! Hey, we really sending Fang out in this?
hash_4129359ba871576e: Rain\xe2\x80\x99s getting worse and winds are still picking up speed. Maybe being a black shoe isn\xe2\x80\x99t so bad after all.
hash_4129389ba8715c87: Strike Team, this Storm is like nothing I\xe2\x80\x99ve ever seen. You\xe2\x80\x99re running out of time.
hash_4129379ba8715ad4: Holy hell... If anyone\xe2\x80\x99s still out there - you need to exfil, and you need to do it now.
hash_41293a9ba8715fed: Energy surges are growing exponentially. Anyone caught out there is gonna be fried - like crispy critter fried - so get out now!
hash_2d22c5e2fa8ed889: Time to move people Merc chatter confirms it - we got a full blown Aether Storm moving across the EZ.
hash_2d22c2e2fa8ed370: SSO, you seeing these sat images? Storm\xe2\x80\x99s here, and it\xe2\x80\x99s no fucking joke.
hash_2d22c3e2fa8ed523: Shit, just lost another drone. This ain\xe2\x80\x99t no passing shower, people.
hash_2d22c8e2fa8edda2: Storm\xe2\x80\x99s touching down in the EZ! Oh man, didn\xe2\x80\x99t think I\xe2\x80\x99d ever be glad to be in the chair.
hash_2d22c9e2fa8edf55: Storm just made landfall. Jesus... never seen power surges like this. We\xe2\x80\x99re in the shit now.
hash_2d22c6e2fa8eda3c: I have eyes on the stormfront. It\xe2\x80\x99s... kinda beautiful. And scary. Really fucking  scary.
hash_4aaf04fbb1c17987: This is Dobbs - a few of my drones just dropped out of the sky. No sign of hostile fire.
hash_4aaf05fbb1c17b3a: Dobbs to Deadbolt Actual - feed just went black on a few of my Class-1s. Working on routing some replacements, but\xe2\x80\xa6 I don\xe2\x80\x99t like this.
hash_4aaf06fbb1c17ced: Deadbolt Actual, I am seeing anomalous energy surges eleven miles up. Hard to tell, but I think we\xe2\x80\x99ve got trouble on the way.
hash_4aaefffbb1c17108: Ah Shit... Dobbs here... Something\xe2\x80\x99s going on with our satellite feed. Trying to get it back online - Oh. Oh no\xe2\x80\xa6
hash_4aaf00fbb1c172bb: Dobbs to SSO Greene - I\xe2\x80\x99m seeing multiple Terminus convoys trying to flee the EZ. Makes me wonder if they have intel we don\xe2\x80\x99t. Can\xe2\x80\x99t imagine what, unless...
hash_4aaf01fbb1c1746e: Deadbolt Actual, this is Dobbs - you may want to take a look at that weather report I just sent over. Seems like we\xe2\x80\x99ve got something big in the works.
hash_21682e58f88bd7c3: Fang here - I\xe2\x80\x99m on my way, but I don\xe2\x80\x99t like the look of this thing. Don't keep me waiting.
hash_21682f58f88bd976: Hold position, team - I\xe2\x80\x99m threading this Storm fast as I can.
hash_21683058f88bdb29: Affirmative, Strike Team. Let\xe2\x80\x99s make this snappy - I forgot my umbrella.
hash_21683158f88bdcdc: Never met a storm I couldn\xe2\x80\x99t outfly. At least, not yet. See you soon, Strike Team.
hash_6d186a4a2752a45f: Dammit - I can't hold any longer. Fang here, we are RTB.
hash_6d186b4a2752a612: Time\xe2\x80\x99s up - there\xe2\x80\x99s nothing more I can do. Extract helo departing the AO.
hash_6d186c4a2752a7c5: If you\xe2\x80\x99re still out there... I\xe2\x80\x99m sorry. Can\xe2\x80\x99t hold out any longer. Fang out.
